items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: all of June Richmond's vocals I was doing... June and I had a ball together.

ctx.x: Yeah, I wrote that up for him. And quite a few things I wrote. And all of June Richmond's vocals I was doing. With Andy I was having a ball, man. The money was nice, and every time I asked for a raise I'd get one. So I got it up to thirty-five dollars a night...
And the band was a pretty happy band, I guess, with each other...
